Game Overview

Birdonaut puts players into a casual experience centered on embark on a cosmic adventure as a daring birdonaut. Navigate through space, dodging asteroids while collecting shiny coins and juicy fruits. Master quick flaps to keep afloat and embrace the nostalgic charm of retro arcade action. How long can you soar among the stars?

Playing Birdonaut comes down to a simple loop. Embark on a cosmic adventure as a daring birdonaut! Navigate through space, dodging asteroids while collecting shiny coins and juicy fruits.
